profile.headline: Software Engineering | Technical Architecture | Enterprise Solutions
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I excel at leading technical investigations to scope out work, bringing innovative features to the market, and providing strategic technical direction. I thrive in collaborative environments, working closely with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless project execution. I pursue excellence relentlessly and commit to quality assurance.

My track record of driving team productivity and fostering a culture of continuous improvement has resulted in successful project outcomes. I take pride in my ability to align business objectives with technical requirements, ensuring efficient implementation and timely delivery.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer IV
positions.description:
Tech Lead for the content management system team on the VTS Activate product; Evaluated new projects with product managers and designers, performed technical investigations, and scoped work for the engineering team.

Rearchitected the VTS Lease application using domain-driven design to improve engineering's understanding of the codebase, teams' ability to release features independently, and general reliability; Led event-storming sessions to map out the application's features, identifying which features formed logical groupings called domains; Introduced directories into the codebase representing each domain; Established interfaces for interacting with a domain.

Implemented GraphQL to reduce the time spent developing and maintaining APIs; Advanced API discoverability and documentation; Replaced REST resources with duplicate representations with GraphQL Object Types.

Migrated performance monitoring infrastructure from NewRelic to DataDog.

Recognized as one of the top 3 interviewers in the company for conducting a high volume of engineer interviews.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Localized the VTS Lease application; tokenized user-facing text; integrated the application with Transfix a third-party translation service.

Developed in-house libraries to handle business-specific logic; calculating cash flows; converting units of measurement.

Implemented typing in Ruby and JavaScript code to catch bugs early in the development process.

Maintained programming languages and frameworks (EOL Updates, Security Updates, and more).

Maintained third-party libraries (EOL Updates, Security Updates, and more).

Improved CI reliability, identifying and fixing intermittently failing tests.

positions.title: Senior Applications Engineer
positions.description:
Led development of web applications for registering patients into clinical trials.

Spearheaded development of backend services for Medidata’s in-house mobile clinical trial apps; Medidata’s mobile SDK that allowed third-party developers to build their own mobile clinical trial apps; Collecting patient data from third-party wearable devices.

Introduced AWS CloudFormation for maintaining backend service infrastructure.

Boosted customer satisfaction and retention by 90%, resolving customer complaints promptly through ZenDesk.

positions.title: Applications Engineer
positions.description:
Developed web applications for registering patients into clinical trials.

Developed backend services for Medidata’s in-house mobile clinical trial apps; Medidata’s mobile SDK that allowed third-party developers to build their own mobile clinical trial apps; Collecting patient data from third-party wearable devices.

positions.title: Front-End Engineer
positions.description:
Built responsive client-side e-commerce applications including browse and product detail pages.

Integrated Google Analytics with our client-side applications to capture up to 10 million monthly user and bot interactions and use that data to determine marketing campaigns' success and variants in A/B tests.
